verdicts.evidence: lines 444-452, 454-490, 603-613, 635-647, 688-694, 730-750: Undo, Check contacts, Show more, Change the CSV, both downloads, Import, Stop, Resume and Start a new import all have listeners that do what the label names.

lines 469-478, 494-533, 555-594: rows, counts and statuses come from the user's CSV and api.validateImport; lines 666-684 progress from api.runImport. No hardcoded sample values or placeholder text in the markup (115-205).

lines 495-515: review shows row counts, column-mapping notes and the rows themselves. Lines 653, 684, 699-716: import step shows total being imported, done of total, and how many problem rows were left out.

lines 389, 396-397, 773-776: CSV text saved to sessionStorage on input and restored on reload. Lines 482-484: server error leaves the textarea untouched. Lines 761-762: Back then Forward reopens the review from kept state.

lines 528-529: preselected filter only changes which rows are listed. Line 533, 663, 727: focus lands on headings, not on Import. Lines 427-437: file load that replaces text offers Undo. Default submit (141) only checks, imports nothing.
lines 454-490, 641-647: paste, Check contacts, Import N contacts, all in one page with no dialogs. The one extra step is the review the brief requires before anything is imported.

lines 117-203: step list, file input, textarea, review summary, filter, table, progress, outcome. Download of problem and not-imported rows (153, 199) and the filter (156-163) support seeing problem rows and going ahead with good ones. No stat cards or tips.

line 141: one primary in step 1. Lines 517-520: Import is primary, Change the CSV becomes primary only when Import is hidden. Lines 720, 725: resume primary when rows remain, otherwise restart is; never both.

lines 724-725, 739-750: Start a new import clears the CSV; it is plain-styled whenever unimported rows remain and primary only after everything importable is in. Line 191: Stop import is plain. No destructive action is tied to Enter.

lines 465, 690-691: aria-disabled is set only on Check and Stop while their own request runs, with a busy label. Lines 518, 521, 524, 592, 719-724: controls that cannot be used are hidden; line 502 says what to do when nothing can be imported.
lines 115-205 and all script: no title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere.
lines 115-205, 328-366, 409-438, 484, 498-527, 692-723: all visible text is about contacts, rows, the CSV and the import. No mention of implementation, mocking or the request.

line 134 format hint at the textarea; 435 replaced-text note beside Undo; 505 'will not be imported' above the Import button; 512-513 column mapping notes on review; 714-716 skipped rows beside the download. Each sits at the decision it informs.

lines 126-141: labels plus one format hint at the textarea, no text narrating the page. 'Select Check contacts to try again' (484) and 'Fix them in the CSV, then check again' (502) are next steps in an error or blocked state.

line 134: hint gives the column format, not a restatement of the label 'Contacts as CSV text'. Lines 504-505: summary adds the ready count and consequence to the heading. Lines 588-590: caption gives the shown count, not a repeat of a heading.
lines 115-205, 498-527, 702-723: headings and messages state counts and actions. No greeting, slogan or congratulation; the only '!' is the aria-hidden cell marker at 545.

lines 141, 152, 191, 200, 519, 522, 593, 721, 723: Check contacts, Change the CSV, Stop import, Start a new import, Import N contacts, Download the N rows with problems, Show N more rows, Import the remaining N contacts. Undo (129) sits in its note.

lines 361-367: REQUIRED, EMAIL_FORMAT, PHONE_FORMAT, DUPLICATE_IN_CRM are mapped to sentences with a plain fallback. Lines 169-174, 257: column heads are Row, Name, Email, Phone, Company, Status. No codes or field names shown.

line 484: 'The server did not answer, so the contacts were not checked. Your CSV is unchanged. Select Check contacts to try again.' Lines 706-708, 721: interrupted import states saved and unsaved counts with a resume button. err.message is never shown.

lines 328-366, 409-423, 484, 501-502, 705-708: wording such as 'Name is missing', 'Email is not a valid address', 'The server stopped answering part way through'. No 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', capitals or exclamation sentences.

lines 328, 357: empty or header-only input is rejected in the form before review. Line 524: the filter is shown only when both problem and ready rows exist, so the table (165-178) is never rendered with zero rows.
lines 357, 524, 482-484: the table cannot be empty for any reason; a failed check keeps the user on step 1 with its own message, and no filter choice can match nothing.

lines 482-484: failed check shows a message above the Check button, CSV kept, same button retries. Lines 673-678, 705-721: failed import says so, keeps the saved count and offers 'Import the remaining N contacts'.
lines 465-467: button reads 'Checking N rows...' at once. Lines 188-191, 661-662, 681-685: import shows a progress bar and 'x of y imported'; lines 688-694: Stop import aborts it.
lines 470-481: the review is only built after the response arrives, and there is no empty state for the table (line 357, 524), so no loading-versus-empty pair exists.

lines 81-84: fixed table layout with overflow-wrap anywhere. Lines 264, 580-593: 100 rows at a time with Show more. Line 354: short rows become empty strings; 547 shows 'missing' for required blanks. Line 266, 276: numbers formatted.
lines 389, 396-397, 773-776: the CSV draft is saved on every input and restored on return. Lines 754-760, 769-771: leaving during a running import is blocked or prompts via beforeunload.

lines 133-135: 'First row: name, email, phone, company. Every contact needs a name and an email.' is shown under the label before any input and tied by aria-describedby. Line 126: the file label says CSV.

line 126: file field labelled '(optional)' and line 133 textarea unmarked, so status is knowable from words. But the textarea is required (line 328 rejects empty) and carries no required or aria-required attribute (line 135), so the attribute does not match.
lines 396-401: the input listener only clears an existing error, never raises one. Lines 454-461: parsing errors appear on submit only.

lines 135-136, 390-393: CSV error renders directly under the textarea, with a 2px border (62) and a 'Problem: ' text prefix (48). Line 128: file error under the file input. Line 139: server error, tied to no field, sits by the submit button.
lines 460, 482-484: neither a client rejection nor a server failure touches csv.value; the draft also stays in sessionStorage (389).
line 460: on rejection setCsvError then csv.focus(). Lines 390-393: aria-invalid='true' set on the textarea. Line 135: aria-describedby includes csv-error, which is role=alert (136).

line 141: Check contacts is never disabled at rest. Lines 328, 460: submitting empty shows 'Paste CSV text or load a file.' and focuses the textarea. Lines 465, 487: aria-disabled only while the check is in flight.

lines 456, 463-466, 486: 'checking' flag ignores a second submit and the button shows 'Checking N rows...'. Line 642: Import ignored while run.active, and the view switches (645). Line 731: resume guarded the same way.

lines 464-466: Check changes label synchronously. Line 645: Import switches view at once. Lines 690-692: Stop becomes 'Stopping...'. Lines 596-601, 603-606: filter and Show more re-render synchronously. Lines 625-630: download starts at once.

lines 494-533: check result is the review heading and table. Lines 696-727: import outcome heading and text state done, stopped or interrupted with counts. Line 484: check failure stated. Lines 435-438: file load result stated.

lines 438, 450: 'file loaded below (N lines)' and 'Your earlier text is back.' confirm a change already visible in the textarea, though they add file name and line count. Line 702: 'N contacts imported' reports an unseen result. Two readings disagreed.

lines 128, 136, 139: errors are inline and are cleared only by new input or a new submit (396-401, 457). Lines 129, 435-436: the note carrying Undo stays until the text is edited. No timers dismiss any visible message.
lines 427-437, 444-452: loading a file over existing text happens at once with no confirmation, and an Undo button restores the earlier text.

lines 495-522: import is preceded by a review naming counts and what is left out, button 'Import N contacts', focus on heading. But lines 739-750: Start a new import wipes the CSV and remaining-row list in one click with no prompt or undo. Verdicts differed.
lines 769-771: the only confirmation is the browser's leave prompt, raised only while an import is running. No confirmation on check, back, stop, download or restart.
lines 470-481, 666-678: the screen changes only after the server answers or reports progress; nothing is updated optimistically.
lines 115-205 and all script: no dialog element, overlay or modal is created.
lines 115-205 and all script: no modal dialogs.

lines 115-143: step 1 opens on the file input and the large textarea. Lines 146-178: review leads with the problem count heading, the import action, then the rows. Lines 185-202: progress and outcome are the only content in step 3.
lines 115-121: h1 'Import contacts' and a one-line step list, then the form. No hero, greeting or intro panel.
lines 498-505, 525-527: the only numbers are rows with problems, rows ready and total, which decide whether to go ahead. Lines 684, 706-708: imported of total during and after the run.

lines 156-163, 525-527: the active filter is a visible radio with counts, and 'All rows (N)' clears it in one action. Lines 585-590: caption states what is shown and how many, e.g. 'Showing all 12 rows with problems.'

lines 124-201: only native form, file input, textarea, radio and button elements. Lines 382, 460, 533, 663, 727: focus is moved to the new heading or field on each step. Lines 607-610: focus kept when Show more disappears.

lines 542-547: wrong cells get a '!' marker and 'missing' text besides colour; 563-573 status column gives the problem in words or 'Ready'. Line 48: errors prefixed 'Problem: '. Line 39: current step is bold and underlined.

lines 128, 136, 139: role=alert containers present on load. Lines 129, 166, 189, 195, 205: role=status regions for file note, row count, progress, outcome and a general status, all in the initial markup and filled later (278, 588, 684, 713).
lines 115-205: no accordions, menus, comboboxes or tabs. The filter is a native radio group and Show more appends rows rather than toggling a region.

lines 99-110: under 700px buttons stack full width and table rows become labelled blocks via data-label. Line 51: file input max-width 100%; line 57: textarea width 100%; line 77: radio choices wrap. No dialogs or fixed-width containers.
